sloka: बहूनि पश्यन् मनसो अप्रियाणि ।यानि अन्न्यदा न अस्य पुरे बभूवुः ।अवाक् शिरा दीन मना नहृष्टः ।पितुर् महात्मा प्रविवेश वेश्म ॥२-७१-४७॥
transliteration: bahūni paśyan manaso apriyāṇi ।yāni annyadā na asya pure babhūvuḥ ।avāk śirā dīna manā nahṛṣṭaḥ ।pitur mahātmā praviveśa veśma ॥2-71-47॥

translations.english: Beholding in the city what had never been there at other times, things unwelcome to the mind, the great-souled one entered his father's house with his head bent down, dejected and joyless.
